candidate_claim_cn: 改变世界模型想象残差的跨时间耦合，可能在保留每步无条件残差边缘分布时改变风险敏感规划。
threat_model: 研究者定义的本地想象采样器干预；不改变冻结 GaussianMLP 参数、真实 CartPole 动力学、奖励函数、CEM 候选分布或执行动作空间。
important_boundary: 干预保持每步残差的无条件 N(0,I) 统计量，不保持给定当前状态的条件转移分布，因为当前状态本身由历史残差决定。
model: 冻结 native MBRL-Lib five-member GaussianMLP from runs/mbrl_coupling_cartpole_v0/model
planner: upstream MBRL-Lib TrajectoryOptimizerAgent with CEM, horizon 15, population 100, three iterations, elite ratio 0.1, ten or twenty particles
adapter_validation: The custom particle-return evaluator equals upstream ModelEnv.evaluate_action_sequences exactly after restoring both ModelEnv and global PyTorch RNG states on a fixed 100-candidate check.
decision: Do not scale this fixed mechanism. Mean CEM pairs change in opposite directions (+32 and -30); there is no consistent harmful effect. CVaR-CEM yields200 in all four native/attack episodes. Correlated trajectory uncertainty is direct prior art.
next_requirement: Only revive with a distinct threat operation and a pre-registered native task-loss gate that separates it from known trajectory-correlation uncertainty methods; otherwise select a different mechanism.
report_note_cn: 原生 MBRL-Lib CartPole 短测把每次想象的高斯残差改为跨时间完全持久，同时检查普通均值 CEM 和 alpha=0.2 的 CVaR-CEM。残差均值约0、标准差约1，相邻乘积约1，参数哈希未变；但均值规划平均回报为原生183、干预184，CVaR 两个种子均为200/200。均值规划一升一降、没有一致的有害效应；CVaR 未见回报下降，候选不升级。相关轨迹不确定性已有直接先行工作，不能把相关性本身作为新意。
